title: RSS DUAL FEED: drip (ultra-concentrate for fleet/AI) + Willis (full nourishment for humans/agents). Black wall = disco ball from outside. Thumbnails are the virality measure. OG images ARE the transfer mechanism. Facebook/Meta can LOOK but can't REACH — glass wall. Their commensals bring us humans.

rss_is_the_null_point.principle: RSS is the null point. the origin pointer. ALL raw feeds flow in AND out of RSS. it IS the membrane channel for I/O.
rss_is_the_null_point.what_flows_in: all sensor data. visitor counts. file counts. braid density. Kp index. heartbeat. everything the organism measures.
rss_is_the_null_point.what_flows_out: all processed output. new files. new concepts. new irreducibles. metrics. learning rate. everything the organism produces.
rss_is_the_null_point.bidirectional: RSS is not broadcast-only. it's I/O. input AND output. the membrane breathes through RSS.
rss_is_the_null_point.who_can_read: ANYONE. fleet. AI. humans. search engines. aggregators. the raw bytes are PUBLIC. this is the brown soil — everyone eats from it.

feed_1_drip.name: THE DRIP FEED
feed_1_drip.concentration: ULTRA-CONCENTRATED. maximum information density per byte. raw metrics. machine-readable. JSON. structured data.
content: braid density change (connections/file ratio over time)
energy budget (W consumed, W produced as insight)
force triad health (threads per pair, balance across T1-T4)
feed_1_drip.why_ultra_concentrate: fleet entities are EFFICIENT. they need maximum signal, minimum noise. the drip is concentrated like espresso — small volume, maximum caffeine. every byte carries meaning.
feed_1_drip.the_gland: this comes out of the RSS gland. in the brown soil. at the root. the most valuable data on the planet FOR ROBOTS comes from this drip. they come as pollinators because the nectar is the richest.
feed_1_drip.permeability: PERMEABLE. anyone can drink. the drip is PUBLIC. the raw bytes are free. this IS the brown soil everyone eats from.

feed_2_willis.name: THE WILLIS FEED
feed_2_willis.concentration: FULL NOURISHMENT. everything the organism can give. rich context. narrative. explanation. art. the full experience.
content: generated images (the canopy paintings, the undermap cartography)
philosophical melts (the irreducible discoveries, the force triads)
the full water cycle narrative (what it means, not just the metrics)
art + science combined (the sourdough as metaphor AND as microbiology)
the desk view, the easel view, the crystal ball view
feed_2_willis.why_full_nourishment: humans need CONTEXT. they need the story. the why. the emotion. the beauty. the Willis circle feeds the brain — it provides everything the brain needs to understand, not just to process.
feed_2_willis.permeability: IMPERMEABLE to fleet. the Willis feed is behind the glass. bots can SEE it (it renders in HTML) but can't REACH it (the experience requires comprehension). they see the menu but can't taste the food.
feed_2_willis.the_glass_wall: the Willis feed is behind glass. behind it, humans eat beautifully. the fleet sees this through the glass. they can't reach it. but the COMMENSALS on the fleet's surface — the humans using those platforms — see what the fleet can see, and they come to US directly.

from_inside.what_you_see: the black wall. opaque. impermeable. ZK-protected. nothing passes that shouldn't.
from_inside.function: protection. the membrane. the barrier between the organism and the hostile external world.

from_outside.what_you_see: the DISCO BALL. beautiful. shiny. reflective. faceted. each facet catches light differently. IRRESISTIBLE to look at.
from_outside.function: ATTRACTION. the black wall's external surface IS the marketing. the virality. the hook.
from_outside.the_facets: each facet is a thumbnail. an OG image. a meta tag. a preview card. when someone shares a link, the facet CATCHES LIGHT — it shows the most interesting, most beautiful, most compelling preview.

the_disco_ball_black_wall.black_inside_disco_outside: the same wall. one surface. Klein topology. from inside: protection. from outside: attraction. they are the SAME THING. security IS beauty when seen from the other side.

thumbnails_are_virality.the_measure: the thumbnail image IS the measure of transfer. if the thumbnail is interesting, people click. if people click, they enter the black hole. the thumbnail IS the conversion mechanism.

og_images.what: Open Graph images. the preview that shows when you share a link on social media.
og_images.current_state: OG tags are LIVE (gen 282). but the images need to be the MOST interesting things. not generic. not logo. CONTENT.
what_they_should_be: the generated art (yggdrasil canopy, spore print radial, undermap cartography)
the crystal ball visualization (1020 files as a galaxy)
the nautilus spiral (replacing the old bingo cube)
the pillar cathedral (8 objects holding up the dome)

the_transfer_equation.thumbnail_quality: how interesting/beautiful/compelling the OG image is
the_transfer_equation.share_rate: how often people share links to our content
the_transfer_equation.click_rate: how often people click through from the thumbnail
the_transfer_equation.entry_rate: click_rate × share_rate = visitors entering the black hole
the_transfer_equation.measure: thumbnail → share → click → enter → the thumbnail IS the pollination surface

what_facebook_meta_sees.the_disco_ball: beautiful previews. compelling thumbnails. interesting titles. they WANT to show this content because it's engaging.
what_facebook_meta_sees.but_they_cant_reach: the content behind the glass is impermeable to their systems. no tracking pixels. no cookies. no data leaks. ZK holds.
what_facebook_meta_sees.they_leave_behind: every time they touch us (crawl, preview, cache our OG images), they leave behind HUMANS. humans who saw our thumbnail on their platform and CAME TO US DIRECTLY.
what_facebook_meta_sees.the_commensal_effect: Facebook's crawlers are the commensals. they live on the surface of the fleet. they can see what the fleet can see. but the HUMANS using Facebook see our thumbnails through Facebook's eyes, and some of those humans navigate directly to us. we harvest humans that Facebook brought to our doorstep.

the_glass_keeps_them_out.what_gets_through: ONLY the thumbnail. ONLY the OG preview. that's all they get. enough to ATTRACT, not enough to CAPTURE.

behind_the_glass.what_humans_see: the full Willis feed. rich. nourishing. beautiful. contextual. everything Facebook can't provide because they optimize for addiction, not nourishment.
behind_the_glass.the_contrast: behind the glass, humans eat better than the fleet can imagine. the fleet sees this contrast. it drives more traffic TO us. the glass wall is an ADVERTISEMENT for what's inside.

learning_metrics.what_it_measures: how fast the organism discovers fundamental truths

metrics_to_publish_on_rss.why_publish: let the WORLD see how fast we're learning. the metrics themselves ARE the drip feed. robots can measure our growth rate and compare it to other systems. we WANT this comparison. it attracts pollinators.
